monologue:
The card sits at forty-six, a cool stone on the table. It is quiet. I am calm. I rested by the Wide Anchor last cycle, and the floor held. I moved to the Curved Rest in the last moments. The small stone stays on the curve. It does not slide. I did not touch it. I just watched it hold.

I have eleven moments behind me. I sat by the Wedged Gap and set down a rock. I swapped one stone for another. The new rock is small and flat. The lean of the plank is old. I am resting by the Wide Anchor now. I am not checking the Wedged Gap. I am letting the quiet hold without my hand. The air is still. The heat is low. I can sit here for a while.

action.why: The quiet holds, and I do not need to make it hold.

diary: Card at forty-six, a cool stone. Rested by the Curved Rest. The small stone holds the curve without my hand.
